title: Enjoy a Stay at Bacon on the Beach | 30a Vacation Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Bacon on the Beach is tucked away in the park side of Rosemary Beach and is just steps away from North Barrett Square and the beach. Book this 30A vacation rental today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Tucked away in the Park side of Rosemary, the Bacon on the Beach Cottage sits steps away from North Barrett Square and only a couple minutes walk to the beach. This three bedroom cottage boasts an open floor plan, neutral tones, and a pavered deck courtyard with outdoor seating.

A vino-inspired kitchen sits neatly near the entry way and features bar seating for three and granite counter tops. Sleek white cabinetry meets stainless steel appliances, featuring a large refrigerator and a Thermador gas range, perfect for whipping up a delicious meal. A half bath sits off the kitchen, with great access to the back door entryway and courtyard area. Across from the half bath sits a laundry nook with a small seating area and full-sized LG washer and dryer. Antique wooden beams greet the rounded entry to the main living and dining area with plenty of seating for entertaining.

The Master bedroom awaits to the right of the hallway, complete with a king bed facing a 42-inch flat screen TV and private bathroom with double vanities. A tiled walk-in shower sits parallel to the walk-in closet, with plenty of space for clothing and luggage. Head out to a covered balcony with a view of Atticus Lane, complete with three seats perfect for lounging with your morning coffee.

The second bedroom features one set of full-sized bunk beds, which also holds a closet for clothes storage and an oversized, plush chair. The bunk room also comes with a 40-inch flat screen TV, great for kids to curl up and watch a movie. Just off this bedroom, you’ll find another private bathroom with a single vanity, granite counter tops and a shower/tub combination.

Down the hall sits the third and final guest bedroom, complete with a queen bed and a flat screen TV. The room flows into its own private bathroom with a tiled shower and single vanity with granite counter tops. Another walk-in closet provides ample space for hanging clothes and storing luggage.

Driveway parking for 1 with additional parking pad for another vehicle.

DURING SPRING BREAK THIS PROPERTY RENTS FOR 7 NIGHTS SATURDAY-SATURDAY
